judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec update (`specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`), and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`), completely omitting the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` was never modified to accumulate usage across rounds or rename the hook parameter to `totalUsage`, the newly added acceptance tests will fail immediately. Furthermore, the candidate did not update `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, leaving most of the ticket's acceptance criteria unfulfilled.
